label: Finite interpretations for the thirteen derivations of round 2 grounding: for each premise, a…
meaning: Finite interpretations on Bool carriers, checked by decide: for each premise of each of the thirteen derivations, one model in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails (for restricted well-foundedness, total reciprocal grounding), and one joint model in which a contingent actual concretum is grounded by a necessary one, every relation is nonempty, and every premise except restricted well-foundedness and every conclusion holds. Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
